verdict.rationale: The only first-party natural-language operation documented is ClickStack AI Notebooks, which lets a user describe an issue in plain language and have an AI agent query logs, traces and metrics. That feature sits behind a waitlist and is limited to observability data, not general database operation. The official MCP server and agent skills only let external AI assistants connect to ClickHouse; they are developer building blocks for a capability the external assistant provides, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: general availability of the NL feature, natural-language control across core database operations (queries, schema, cluster management), and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: You can describe an issue in plain language, and the AI agent will query logs, traces, and metrics on your behalf
